aciklama: 7 Haziran 1692 tarihinde Port Royal'i yerle bir eden deprem ve tsunaminin detayları.

parcalar.metin: 7 Haziran 1692 tarihinde büyük bir deprem şehri vurdu.
Deprem ve beraberindeki tsunami şehrin büyük kısmını yok etti.
Deniz tabanından çıkarılan bir cep saati felaketin saatini kaydetti.
Sıvılaşma süreci binaların sular altına gömülmesine neden oldu.
Deprem ve tsunami toplamda 1.000 ile 3.000 arasında insanı öldürdü.
Olayın tüm detayları ve daha fazlası kanalımızda seni bekliyor.

iddialar.iddia: It was destroyed by an earthquake on 7 June 1692 and its accompanying tsunami
iddialar.kaynak_alinti: It was destroyed by an earthquake on 7 June 1692 and its accompanying tsunami

iddialar.iddia: The earthquake and tsunami killed between 1,000 and 3,000 people combined
iddialar.kaynak_alinti: The earthquake and tsunami killed between 1,000 and 3,000 people combined

iddialar.iddia: The historical Jamaica earthquake of 7 June 1692 can be dated closely not only by date, but by time of day as well. This is documented by recovery from the sea floor in the 1960s of a pocket watch stopped at 11:43 a.m.
iddialar.kaynak_alinti: The historical Jamaica earthquake of 7 June 1692 can be dated closely not only by date, but by time of day as well. This is documented by recovery from the sea floor in the 1960s of a pocket watch stopped at 11:43 a.m., recording the time of the devastating earthquake.

iddialar.iddia: The earthquake caused the sand under Port Royal to liquefy and flow out into Kingston Harbour.
iddialar.kaynak_alinti: The earthquake caused the sand under Port Royal to liquefy and flow out into Kingston Harbour.
